summary: Banco Santander, S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim unaudited consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign issuer, presenting standard balance sheet, income statement, and notes under Spanish regulatory framework. No event that triggers a special-situations category—such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change—is described. The document is purely financial reporting with no transactional catalyst.
